headline: Budget committee reviews Bill 55, approves cuts and bus fare change, adjourns until tomorrow

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: New grant condition of $250,000 as a line item
meeting.summary: Members made budget changes under Bill 55, including a $140,000 Category A cut and $170,000 for bus hub security, and removed student ages from bus fare rules. The committee plans to meet tomorrow at 10.
meeting.recap: The committee reviewed department budgets in Bill 55.[[0:05:54]] Members added liquor fee classes missing from one fee schedule version.[[0:09:40]] Members approved a $250,000 grant condition, with nine ayes.[[0:13:00]] Members cut $140,000 from the same department's Category A budget, with nine ayes.[[0:14:12]] Members voted nine ayes to list the department's pending grants in the budget.[[0:24:36]] A council member proposed cutting $35,000 for rented training space in Personnel Services.[[0:26:54]] The cut failed on a roll call vote, corrected to four ayes and five noes.[[0:32:09]] Members added $170,000 for security at the bus hub, with nine ayes.[[0:48:37]] A council member proposed removing student ages from bus fare rules, so students with valid ID qualify.[[0:50:35]] The fare change passed with nine ayes.[[0:53:21]] Members voted on adding $3.35 million in bond money for 24 North Church Street.[[0:56:57]] Members cut $670,000 in housing contract services, with nine ayes.[[0:59:24]] The committee adjourned and planned to meet tomorrow at 10.[[1:15:57]]
decided: Members approved a new $250,000 grant condition.
Members approved cutting $140,000 from the department's Category A budget.
Members approved listing the department's pending grants in Appendix A, Part 1.
Members approved cutting $150,000 from the Planning Department's Category A budget.
Members approved removing student ages from the bus fare rules.
Members were called to vote on adding $3.35 million in bond money for 24 North Church Street, but no count or result was stated.
meeting.next: Tomorrow the committee plans to take up Human Concerns, Management, Mayor, Parks and Police. Public Works and Water Supply are also left, with countywide items to be done last. A council member asked that a police budget offset be sent in writing before the committee reaches the police budget.
